profile.ja: 隠居した対魔忍。稲毛屋の店主の婆さんで、アイスづくりの達人。対魔忍随一の房術使いとして名をはせた人物だといい、今でも夜な夜な任務に出掛けるという都市伝説まである。どんな日にも稲毛屋を開けるのがポリシーで、邪魔する者には容赦しない。
profile.en: She is a retired Taimanin, the elderly shopkeeper of Inage-ya and a master ice-cream maker. She is said to have been renowned as the Taimanin's foremost jōjutsu user, and there's even an urban legend that she still goes on missions night after night. Her policy is to keep Inage-ya open every day, and she shows no mercy to anyone who gets in her way.

text.ja: いつもご贔屓ありがとうね。稲毛夏だよ。何だい、その顔は。この姿を見るのは初めてだったかい？
text.en: Thanks for always favoring me. I'm Inage Natsu. What's with that face? Is this the first time you've seen me like this?

text.ja: この姿の時はお婆ちゃんじゃなくて、“夏”と呼んでおくれ
text.en: When I'm in this form, don't call me "grandma," just call me "Natsu."

text.ja: ふふふ、任務に応じて姿を変えるのは忍びの基本だろう？
text.en: Hehe, changing my appearance to suit the mission is just a ninja's basic skill, right?

text.ja: くれぐれも無理はするんじゃないよ。何事も身体が資本なんだからね
text.en: Please don't push yourself too hard. Your body is your foundation, after all.

text.ja: そろそろ出かけようか。ほら、あんたも若いんだから、しゃんとしなさいな
text.en: Shall we head out soon? Come on, you're still young, so behave properly.

text.ja: 物好きだね。経絡に興味があるのかい？　だったら、あんたの身体で試してみようかねぇ
text.en: You're quite the curious type. Interested in meridians, huh? Then how about I try it out on your body?

text.ja: あら、ふうまの坊っちゃん。最近お父上に似てきたねえ。ふふふ、ほんと坊っちゃんのお父上はいい男だったのよ
text.en: Oh, little Fuuma boy. You've been looking more like your father lately. Hehe, your father really was a handsome man.

text.ja: 暇ならお店手伝っておくれ。ちゃあんとお駄賃は用意しておくからね
text.en: If you're free, help out at the shop. I'll make sure you get a proper tip.

text.ja: ふふ、身体もアソコも、ガチガチじゃないか。凝りほぐしてあげるよ。なぁに、こういうのは朝飯前だよ
text.en: Hehe, both your body and… down there are all stiff, huh? Let me loosen you up. This kind of thing is a piece of cake for me.

text.ja: はぁ、はぁ……、良いところに来たね。ちょいと奥に来なよ。火照ったこの身体をどうしようかと考えてたところさ
text.en: Hah, hah… you've come to a good spot. Come a little farther back. I was just thinking about what to do with this heated body of mine.

text.ja: 困ったものだねぇ。年甲斐もなく発情してしまってるよ。後生だから慰めておくれよ。あぁん……っ
text.en: What a trouble… I'm getting all horny despite my age. Please comfort me, you pervert… ahh…
